== Summary ==
Change crop (after) for [[Life Day (Errata)]]: the region (380, 780, 596, 828) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the Players Committee card image of [[Life Day (Errata)]] (PC-E1): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/68ad3bacad81fda51e9730e4dd5e1c0e7b04be54/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/lifeday.gif Holotable commit 68ad3ba] (2024-07-24). The matching before crop is [[:File:V23-L-lifeday-2024-07-24-change-crop-before.png]]. Compared with the image of [[Life Day]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/lifeday.gif commit 335d47f]) and [[Life Day (Errata)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/68ad3bacad81fda51e9730e4dd5e1c0e7b04be54/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/lifeday.gif commit 68ad3ba]).
